title: Estate Mandatory Spec & Closed-Loop Delivery Standard (Zero-Loophole Contract)
summary: Enforces a strict 6-gate specification and delivery template across Argon, DeepSeek, Claude, and MiniMax so no work enters or exits the estate without machine-checkable BDD predicates, 3-tries tool bounds, an Inbox->Consulting->Outbox receipt chain, and a verified artifact manifest.

mandatoryGates.name: Machine-Checkable BDD Given/When/Then
mandatoryGates.rule: Every spec must declare given/when/then where `then` includes at least one executable verifier (`exit_code == 0`, `file_exists:<path>`, `grep_match:<pattern>`, `probe:<cmd>`, `http_status == 200`, `test_pass:<suite>`).
mandatoryGates.loopholeClosed: Eliminates prose-only 'looks good / should work' specs from Claude and MiniMax branches.

mandatoryGates.name: 3-Tries Canonical (tool, args) Fence & Reset Contract
mandatoryGates.rule: Every execution plan locks `max_attempts: 3` per canonical `(tool, args)` key and requires explicit `declare_plan` or `revise_plan` to reset counters.
mandatoryGates.loopholeClosed: Prevents runaway bash/edit loops and colliding worktree thrashing across #7680 and #7692.

mandatoryGates.name: Bidirectional Private-Repo Inbox -> Consulting Poller -> Outbox Chain
mandatoryGates.rule: All cross-repo deliverables and MiniMax M2.7 big-ticket dispatches must enter `relay/inbox/` (chidionyema/estate-inbox), pass Consulting Lane audit (`bin/estate-inbox-poll`), and emit a CIF-HMAC signed receipt in `relay/outbox/` (chidionyema/estate-outbox).
mandatoryGates.loopholeClosed: Closes the broken return loop where push/outbox existed partially but inbound requests and MiniMax big tickets bypassed consulting review.

mandatoryGates.name: Machine-Generated Repo Catalog & SHA-256 Artifact Manifest
mandatoryGates.rule: Every delivery must register its exact file paths, executable CLI probes, and exportable bundle/tarball coordinates in `register/machine-repo-catalog.json`.
mandatoryGates.loopholeClosed: Surfaces hidden repo capabilities (like whole-repo export and Claude's machine-generated catalog) directly to the Founder UI.

mandatoryGates.name: Quantitative Latency, Token Compaction & Budget SLOs
mandatoryGates.rule: Must specify explicit `latency_p99_ms`, `auto_compaction_token_cap` (<= 4096), and `max_budget_usd` (<= $0.50 per hypothesis run).
mandatoryGates.loopholeClosed: Prevents silent context-window blowups and unbudgeted token burn.

mandatoryGates.name: Single-Command Deterministic Rollback
mandatoryGates.rule: Every spec must include a verified 1-line rollback command (`git checkout main -- <paths>` or worktree prune) triggered automatically on post-flight probe failure.
mandatoryGates.loopholeClosed: Prevents half-merged worktrees (e.g., behind 349 commits) from lingering when an agent halts.

mandatoryGates.name: Self-Contained Project Instructions & Private Repo Push
mandatoryGates.rule: Every project, sub-project, catalog entry, and Outbox receipt must include a verified quickstart command (`quickstartCmd`), step-by-step runbook (`README.md` + `INSTRUCTIONS.md`), and be committed/packaged via `bin/estate-push-instructions` before private repo push or export.
mandatoryGates.loopholeClosed: Eliminates undocumented repos or mystery artifacts—every project pushed to private GitHub or exported via .tar.gz/.bundle comes with runnable 30-second instructions.
